AutoSyncIn.description: How a library is checked on its own; the whole set (what is left out takes its default).

tag_pattern.description:
A glob over tag names (`v*`, `release-1.*`), case-sensitive: matching tags with a version
order become `auto` versions. Null imports no tag.
tag_pattern.title: Tag Pattern

keep_last.description: How many `auto` versions are kept, the newest; older ones are removed.
keep_last.title: Keep Last

interval_minutes.description: How often the library is checked.
interval_minutes.title: Interval Minutes

sync_branches.description: Re-sync every branch version at each check.
sync_branches.title: Sync Branches

AutoSyncIn.title: AutoSyncIn

ChunkingIn.description: How a library's articles are cut into chunks (the defaults: one chunk per heading).

split_level.description: The deepest heading that starts a chunk: 2 cuts at `#` and `##` only.
split_level.title: Split Level

min_chars.description:
A chunk shorter than this is merged with the next one (the last with the one before), within
`max_chars`; the text before the first heading is never merged. At most 8,000 when sent: no
chunk is longer.
min_chars.title: Min Chars

max_chars.description:
A chunk longer than this is cut again at its deeper headings; never inside a code block or
table. Null: no bound. At least `min_chars`, and at most 8,000 when sent: whatever the
settings, a section longer than 8,000 characters is split between its top-level blocks.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

chunker.description: `markdown`: cuts at headings with markdown-it-py (the only one supported).
chunker.title: Chunker

ChunkingIn.title: ChunkingIn

SourceLibrary.description:
One library of a sources file. A setting left out is not managed: never compared or changed.

`include_paths`, `exclude_paths` and `tag_rules` are compared as sets, after the server's
normalization (a reordered list or a tag in other letter case is no change).

url.description: HTTPS, HTTP, SSH (`ssh://` or `git@host:org/repo.git`) or file URL, without credentials.
url.title: Url

id.description:
`/owner/repo`, any letter case; left out: the ID derived from `url`, as when a library is
added.
id.title: Id

refs.description:
The versions to have: tags, branches or full 40-character commit SHAs (a short SHA is
refused). The first one is imported when the library is created.
refs.title: Refs

include_paths.description:
Folders, files or globs to import; empty: every `.md`/`.mdx` file (the repository's
`context7.json` does not fill in a managed empty list). Left out: not managed.
include_paths.title: Include Paths

exclude_paths.description: Folders, files or globs to leave out; they win. Left out: not managed.
exclude_paths.title: Exclude Paths

tag_rules.description: Tags for articles by path, as a whole set. Left out: not managed.
tag_rules.title: Tag Rules

chunking.description: How articles are cut into chunks. Left out: not managed.

auto_sync.description:
The scheduled check, as a whole (what it leaves out takes its default); `false` turns it
off. Left out: not managed.
auto_sync.title: Auto Sync

SourceLibrary.title: SourceLibrary

TagRuleIn.description: Articles whose path matches `pattern` (a glob like `docs/api/**`) get `tag`.

tag.description: The tag a matching article gets; normalized like every tag (lower-case, trimmed).
tag.title: Tag

TagRuleIn.title: TagRuleIn

description:
`exactdocs.sources.yaml`: the libraries an instance should have, for code review.

It holds no credential: a private library is added in the UI with its credential first,
then managed by the file.

libraries.description: The declared libraries, each ID once.
libraries.title: Libraries

title: ExactDocs sources file (exactdocs.sources.yaml)
